gloss: at any time; as needed; whenever necessary

definitions.gloss: at any time; as needed; whenever necessary
definitions.explanation: Indicates that something can be done at any time without a fixed schedule, or that something is done on an as-needed basis. Composed of 随 (follow, as one pleases) + 時 (time). Common in formal announcements, business communications, and official notices.

examples.japanese: ご⟦{質問|しつもん}→質問：00888_shitsumon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{随時|ずいじ}⟦{受|う}け{付|つ}けます→受け付ける：05683_uketsukeru⟧。
examples.english: We accept questions at any time.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{入|はい}り→入る：00494_hairu⟧⟦{次第|しだい}→次第：03175_shidai⟧、{随時|ずいじ}⟦{更新|こうしん}します→更新する：27994_koushinsuru⟧。
examples.english: We will update as needed whenever new information comes in.

examples.japanese: ⟦{採用|さいよう}→採用：04563_saiyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{随時|ずいじ}⟦{行|おこな}って→行う：01238_okonau⟧⟦おります→おる：01324_oru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、お⟦{気軽|きがる}→気軽：06865_kigaru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧お⟦{問|と}い{合|あ}わせ→問い合わせる：17737_toiawaseru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: We are hiring on a rolling basis, so please feel free to inquire.

notes:
USAGE:
{随時|ずいじ} is a formal word commonly seen in business emails, official announcements, and signs. It implies flexibility — there is no fixed time or schedule, and the action happens as the situation requires.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {随時|ずいじ}⟦{受付|うけつけ}→受付：01325_uketsuke⟧ (accepting at any time)
- {随時|ずいじ}⟦{募集|ぼしゅう}→募集：03035_boshuu⟧ (recruiting on a rolling basis)
- {随時|ずいじ}⟦{更新|こうしん}→更新：04765_koushin⟧ (updated as needed)
- {随時|ずいじ}⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧ (handling as needed)
